name: Anwen
greeting: The silence held through the night. I kept waking to make sure.
lines: Kael: I felt the road when I woke. Not words. Weight.
Anwen: Then we write the limits now, while people are grateful enough to forget them. You did not accept every order anyone might give you.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She writes that the keeping is Kael's choice. No child inherits it. No shortage can compel another keeper. The old command remains beside it, uncensored.

lines: Kael: If I cannot keep it?
Anwen: We meet again. We tell the truth about the cost. We do not turn your promise into an excuse to stop thinking.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Kael reads the lines before signing. The tremor in his hand is his own.

lines: Anwen: Tor has a repair for you. Something ordinary. Let him do it.
